label: RANKED_ECONOMIC_DIAGNOSIS__L5_vs_ENGINE__R4_THREE_MARKET_SAMPLE

sample.WARNING: three markets, one day. Ranks mechanisms by demonstrated dollars; establishes NO expectancy.

fee_adjustment.why: src/pmus_fees.py exposes no maker_fee at all: a PMUS maker pays no fee and accrues a rebate. All ten fills were maker.
fee_adjustment.rebate_status: UNCONFIRMED CREDIT. Never netted into edge, per the operating model.

extend.note: one further extend was executed as a complete

ranking.mechanism: petbru-alecan filled 1 of 19 orders (5.3%); engine chose complete 18 times and completed nothing; 5.24 YES left naked at cost 1.9912; market settled NO; full basis lost.
ranking.execution_limitation_evidence: complement_not_priceable, 21 refusals, ALL 21 on the NO side, i.e. every one blocking a COMPLETE leg
ranking.behavioral_evidence: 18 complete attempts, 0 completing fills: re-chosen and re-submitted without achieving a fill
ranking.fee_adjusted: unchanged; -1.976 even crediting the unconfirmed rebate
ranking.why_rank_1: it is every realized dollar lost in the sample, and the same sample contains a WORKING completion at 0.8798, so the fix direction is unambiguous

ranking.mechanism: norgom-ollwal matched 10.21 contracts, the largest matched book of the three, at pair cost 0.9992
ranking.discipline_breach: spring discipline prefers <= 0.96 and locks near-$1.00 tolerance as late incentive-era L5 behavior; at 0.9992 it did not bind
ranking.rebate_dominates_margin: rebate accrual 0.0636 is 7.8x the 0.0082 trading margin, so the trade only works as rebate farming, which the operating model forbids as a justification and which is unconfirmed
ranking.grounded_counterfactual_usd: ~1.23 if the same 10.21 pairs had completed at 0.8798, a price the engine actually achieved in a sibling market the same day
ranking.label: counterfactual, but priced at an achieved fill rather than a fitted number

ranking.mechanism: 108 of L5's 109 extends never executed: unmatched_usd_cap 62, entry_band_left 44, off_distribution_hold 1, 1 executed as complete
ranking.note: largest behavioral divergence, zero demonstrated profit impact, negative on the held-to-settlement reading. The positive reading assumes a complement fill that never happened.
ranking.why_not_rank_1: ranking by suppressed behaviour would put this first and would be wrong about profitability

ranking.mechanism: 23 of 37 L5 opens held by off_distribution_hold (62%), 315s of session time
54 of 64 submitted orders never filled (15.6% fill rate). entry_band_left alone consumed 1524s, 35.7% of all live session time -- a larger time sink than the cap's 26%.

answer_to_q5: The failure to complete the second leg. -1.9912 USD, which is 100% of realized losses in the sample. Our biggest behavioral gap (EXTEND) and our biggest economic problem (COMPLETION) are not the same thing.

checked.result: point-in-time scalar only: currentBalance 243.11505, buyingPower and availableToWithdraw identical, unsettledFunds 0, pendingCredit 0, balanceReservation 0, pendingWithdrawals []. No transaction list and lastUpdated is null, so balance-differencing has no venue timestamp to anchor to.
POSITION_RESOLUTION rows carry cashValue "0" and an EMPTY tradeId
present in this repo only as GEMINI candidates explicitly labelled speculative (gemini_settlement_probe.py, gemini_execution/rebate_probe.py). Not PMUS routes we hold.

cashflow_attribution.what_the_balance_does_establish: unsettledFunds 0 with currentBalance == availableToWithdraw means nothing is pending: settlements have cleared into withdrawable cash IN AGGREGATE. The -6.0334 is consistent with cleared cash but cannot be decomposed per market.
cashflow_attribution.action_taken: gap documented, behavioral analysis not blocked on it, as instructed

against_target.this_sample_usd: 0.0043 settlement-implied across 3 markets, no attributed cashflow
against_target.note: noise at a different order of magnitude. Not a scaling problem: a completion mechanism that loses its whole basis when it fails does not improve by running more often.
